_comment: Kara 1.59 and newer, on both platforms, read the entry under platforms for
the machine they run on. Keys are 'windows' and 'mac'.
THE TOP-LEVEL version AND url ARE FOR WINDOWS 1.58 AND OLDER, which only read
the top level. Without them those installs report 'the update source did not
name a version and a zip' and can never update. They MUST name the WINDOWS
zip and match platforms.windows: every Mac build (1.54 onward) reads
platforms first, so it never sees these. Checked against each version's code.
The urls point at release assets. Keep 'windows'/'macos' in the FILENAMES:
a releases feed is matched on the asset name.
The Mac zip is built on Windows: its Kara.app is carried byte-for-byte from
the last Mac-built release so its signature, and the permissions macOS files
under it, survive. Only bump 'mac' to a version whose macos asset exists.
notes: Kara now listens for the names in your profile, so it spells them right more often (on by default; Settings > Writing to turn it off). Opening Kara twice no longer shows a white window, and the grey unsure marks appear even when recordings aren't kept.
